info.title: PRISM Engine API
info.description:
Career-guidance API for PRISM Engine (DataQuest 3.0, problem DQNM).

* Send `Authorization: Bearer <Supabase access token>` on every endpoint except `/health` and `/demo/run`.
* Every error has the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`; quote the `X-Request-ID`
  response header when reporting a bug.
* Mock mode (`USE_MOCKS=true`) answers from fixed demo data and needs no token. Act as the demo
  parent by sending `X-Dev-User: 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222`.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Viable paths first, by final score; filled with non-viable ones (finance.viable = false) when fewer than 5 are viable

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: Non-viable careers that did not make the roadmap

value.title: Value
value.description: likert: 1 = strongly disagree ... 5 = strongly agree; choice: the picked option's value (1-4 = A-D)

index.title: Index
index.description: 100 x the mean of the four gaps

top_gaps.title: Top Gaps
top_gaps.description: The three largest gaps, largest first

agree.title: Agree
agree.description: true to allow the parent-student comparison, false to withdraw

both_consented.title: Both Consented
both_consented.description: True when the linked partner has agreed too

Dimension.title: Dimension
Dimension.description: The 13 trait dimensions. Question dimensions and careers.trait_weights keys use exactly these values.

DomainScore.title: DomainScore
DomainScore.description: Mean of the scores of the careers in this domain.

colleges.title: Colleges
colleges.description: The finance check uses the first college

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: Every error response has this shape.

text.title: Text
text.description: Under 150 words, built only from the numbers in the result

source.title: Source
source.description: Lets the UI tag AI-written vs template text

total_cost.title: Total Cost
total_cost.description: (annual fee + living cost) x duration - matched scholarship

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: What the family can pay over the course without a loan

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Why the path is not viable; empty when viable

loan.title: Loan
loan.description: 1 when the loan is within the family's limit, lower the further above it

payback.title: Payback
payback.description: 1 - breakeven / (2 x the family's tolerance), clamped to 0..1

FinanceParts.title: FinanceParts
FinanceParts.description: finance = 0.5 x capacity_ratio + 0.3 x loan + 0.2 x payback

FitParts.title: FitParts
FitParts.description: fit = 0.5 x aptitude + 0.3 x interest + 0.2 x cognitive

enum: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
IndianState.title: IndianState
IndianState.description: States and union territories, spelled exactly like this everywhere (profiles, market data).

invite_code.title: Invite Code
invite_code.description: Short code the student shares with their parent; single use

MarketParts.title: MarketParts
MarketParts.description: market = 0.5 x demand + 0.3 x growth + 0.2 x salary_percentile, each min-max scaled across careers

matched_rule.title: Matched Rule
matched_rule.description: The eligibility rule the family met, e.g. 'percentage >= 85'

pair.description: Null until the parent redeems the invite code

annual_education_budget.title: Annual Education Budget
annual_education_budget.description: What the family can spend on education each year

max_loan.title: Max Loan
max_loan.description: Largest education loan the family will take

annual_income.title: Annual Income
annual_income.description: Optional; used only to match scholarship income limits

risk_appetite.title: Risk Appetite
risk_appetite.description: 1 = avoids risk ... 5 = very comfortable with risk

breakeven_tolerance_years.title: Breakeven Tolerance Years
breakeven_tolerance_years.description: Years of salary the family accepts to recover the cost

top_domain_ids.title: Top Domain Ids
top_domain_ids.description: The parent's top 3 domains (ids from GET /domains), first choice first

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: So the UI can say who is linked; null if they gave no name

PartnerStatus.title: PartnerStatus
PartnerStatus.description: The linked partner's name and status flags; never their answers.

questions_required.title: Questions Required
questions_required.description: 0 for parents: their assessment is the profile form

assessment_complete.title: Assessment Complete
assessment_complete.description: All required questions answered and the profile saved

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: likert: rate a statement from 1 to 5. choice: pick the one correct option; the server grades it

Question.title: Question
Question.description: One question. Whether a statement is reverse-scored, and which option is correct, stay on the server.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: In display order. Empty for parents: their assessment is the profile form (PUT /profile).

growth_rate.title: Growth Rate
growth_rate.description: Yearly growth in percent, as published by the source

entry_salary.title: Entry Salary
entry_salary.description: Typical starting salary for a fresher

data_quality.title: Data Quality
data_quality.description: 'estimated' when the figure is an estimate or the national figure stands in for missing regional data

RegionMarket.title: RegionMarket
RegionMarket.description: Market figures for one career in one region (or "India" for the national figure).

saved.title: Saved
saved.description: Questions stored by this request; re-sending a question overwrites it

answered.title: Answered
answered.description: Questions this user has answered so far

final.title: Final
final.description: weights.fit x fit + weights.finance x finance + weights.market x market

risk_appetite.title: Risk Appetite
risk_appetite.description: 1 = avoids risk ... 5 = very comfortable with risk

preferred_state.description: Where the student would like to study and work

home_state.description: State of residence; used for state scholarships

category.title: Category
category.description: Optional; used only for scholarship rules

percentage.title: Percentage
percentage.description: Latest board exam percentage; optional, used for merit scholarships

gender.title: Gender
gender.description: Optional; some scholarships are for girls only

value.title: Value
value.description: The number that produced this item: a trait score, demand score, years or rupees

value.title: Value
value.description: Null when the student answered no questions for this dimension

Weights.title: Weights
Weights.description: Weights for the final ranking R = fit*S + finance*F + market*M (backend guide, section 4, step 5).
